=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/review_autofix_step_post_editor_summary.sh:405-485 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The Python decision loop in review_blocked_stale_clear() counts a cap marker from any trusted-login comment when it sits on any line, including the editor summary this step has just posted (which copies the LLM editor summary unchanged), so a forged own-line cap marker plus the "- Labeled `ai:review-blocked`: this pull request" line counts as the newest cap.
  WHY: A forged marker with a different head gives `remove:head_changed` and deletes an `ai:review-blocked` label that a human or the review-blocked judge set, and a forged marker with the same head/support gives `kept:same_head_support` and hides a real stale cap; all reviewers rated this MAJOR (mapped to high), with confidence ranging from 3 to 4.
- scripts/review_autofix_step_post_editor_summary.sh:430-431 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The `cap_not_pr_target` check stops at the newest trusted cap, so if that cap labeled linked issues, the loop keeps the PR label and never reaches an older cap that labeled the PR itself.
  WHY: An earlier cap (no linked issue) labels the PR, and a later cap (after a linked issue is added) labels only the issue and leaves the PR label in place (.github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:1774-1786), so a clean review on a different head/support keeps the stale label, against the spec in issue #9369; all reviewers rated this MAJOR (mapped to high), with confidence ranging from 3 to 5.
- scripts/review_autofix_step_post_editor_summary.sh:430 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The regex `pr_target_re` does not allow for the literal backslashes that the cap writer (`review_autofix.yml`) supposedly emits, so it never matches a real cap body.
  WHY: Every trusted cap would then count as targeting a linked issue (`cap_not_pr_target`) and the label would never be removed; the reviewer rated this BLOCKER (mapped to critical), but anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3 and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash explicitly refuted it (the unquoted heredoc turns \` into a backtick and YAML strips the indent).
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: "Find the newest trusted `<!-- review-autofix-failure-cap:v1 head=<sha> ... support=<sha> -->` marker (same trust rule the evaluate-gate step uses for markers)."
  expected_change_site: scripts/review_autofix_step_post_editor_summary.sh, the Python decision block in review_blocked_stale_clear() (lines 405-433)
  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5]
  EVIDENCE: The gate's trust rule requires both the trusted login and a marker on the comment's last non-empty line (scripts/review_autofix_step_evaluate_gate.sh lines 647 and 679-681), but the PR implements only the author check plus "own line anywhere" (MULTILINE `^...$` with `matches[-1]`); no hunk anchors the marker to the last line, and no test covers a trusted non-cap comment with a cap marker on its own line mid-body.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- scripts/review_autofix_step_post_editor_summary.sh:405, 412-433 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The code accepts a cap marker on any line of any trusted-login comment (MULTILINE `marker_re`, `matches[-1]`, and `pr_target_re.search` anywhere in the body), while the gate's trust rule requires the marker on the last line (scripts/review_autofix_step_evaluate_gate.sh line 679 `last_line(body)`, line 647 CLEAN_RE).
  WHY: The just-posted editor summary (`cat "${EDITOR_SUMMARY_FILE}"`, line 169) is the newest trusted node; a quoted or injected cap marker plus the Labeled line gives `remove:head_changed` and deletes a human- or judge-set label, while a marker alone gives `kept:cap_not_pr_target` or `kept:same_head_support` and hides the real stale cap. Fix: fullmatch the last non-empty line, optionally require the "**AI review/autofix stopped" prefix, and add a test.
- TASK_GAP
  Requirement: "Find the newest trusted `<!-- review-autofix-failure-cap:v1 head=<sha> ... support=<sha> -->` marker (same trust rule the evaluate-gate step uses for markers)."
  Expected change site: scripts/review_autofix_step_post_editor_summary.sh, the Python decision block in review_blocked_stale_clear() (lines 405-433).
  Evidence of absence: Only the author check plus "own line anywhere" is implemented; no last-line anchoring (scripts/review_autofix_step_evaluate_gate.sh lines 647 and 679-681), and no test for a trusted editor summary with a mid-body cap marker.
  SEVERITY: MAJOR
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4
- Hardening (2 related items): scripts/review_autofix_step_post_editor_summary.sh around lines 418-420 (skip the node unless the last non-empty line fullmatches `marker_re`, ~4 lines); tests/test_review_blocked_stale_clear.py near test_marker_quoted_mid_line_is_ignored (add an editor-summary node with a forged cap and assert kept with no DELETE, ~6 lines). HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 3
- Rejected claims (not reported as findings): the `pr_target_re` backslash claim (the rendered cap line matches; fixtures in tests/test_review_blocked_stale_clear.py lines 88-89), and older PR-labeled cap masking (judged the fail-safe direction); confirmed the `already_absent` branch is reachable (scripts/gh_helpers.sh around lines 1265-1297, line 455).

=== FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite ===
- scripts/review_autofix_step_post_editor_summary.sh:430 | severity=BLOCKER | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The regex `pr_target_re = re.compile(r"^- Labeled `ai:review-blocked`: this pull request", re.MULTILINE)` misses the literal backslashes that the cap writer (`review_autofix.yml`) emits.
  WHY: It never matches the real cap body, so every trusted cap counts as `cap_not_pr_target` and `ai:review-blocked` is never removed.
- scripts/review_autofix_step_post_editor_summary.sh:405-433 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The decision loop scans all trusted-author comments without checking whether the comment is the "AI autofix editor summary".
  WHY: An editor summary that quotes a cap marker can cause premature label removal (forged head) or hide the real stale cap (same head/support).
- scripts/review_autofix_step_post_editor_summary.sh:430-431 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: `cap_not_pr_target` blocks label clearing when the newest trusted cap labeled linked issues.
  WHY: If an earlier cap labeled the PR and a later cap labeled a linked issue, a clean re-review with a new head/support wrongly keeps the stale PR label.
=== END FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite ===

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
- scripts/review_autofix_step_post_editor_summary.sh:430-431 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: `cap_not_pr_target` keeps the label whenever the newest trusted cap labeled linked issues, whatever the head/support comparison shows, while the spec in issue #9369 step 3 requires removal when the newest cap exists and head/support differ.
  WHY: A PR labeled by an earlier cap (review_autofix.yml:1774-1787) that later gains a linked issue and a newer issue-only cap keeps the label indefinitely, because each clean re-dispatch sees the same linked-issue cap.
- Hardening: scripts/review_autofix_step_post_editor_summary.sh, Python loop after the trusted-login check at lines 412-420; the just-posted editor summary (line 484) can count as the newest cap. Fix: skip bodies that do not start with `**AI review/autofix stopped` (review_autofix.yml:1805) and add an assertion in `test_pr_target_wording_matches_the_cap_writer` (~3 lines). HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 3
- Refuted the regex backtick BLOCKER (`.github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:1811` unquoted `<<EOF` emits literal backticks).
=== END FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM openai_gpt-6-luna ===
- scripts/review_autofix_step_post_editor_summary.sh:415-420, 430, 483-484 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The parser accepts any trusted-bot comment that contains a cap marker and the PR-target line, and it does not exclude the editor summary posted unchanged just before the scan.
  WHY: Untrusted review content can make the summary carry those lines, which can remove `ai:review-blocked` on a forged head or hide a real stale cap. Fix: require the genuine cap header or exclude the just-posted summary.
- scripts/review_autofix_step_post_editor_summary.sh:430-431; .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:1774-1786 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The `cap_not_pr_target` branch keeps the PR label whenever the newest trusted cap labeled linked issues.
  WHY: An earlier cap labels the PR, and a later cap labels the issues without removing the PR label; a clean review on a different head/support then keeps the stale label, against the issue's rule.
- Hardening: scripts/review_autofix_step_post_editor_summary.sh:415-420. Require the cap header or exclude the just-posted summary, and add a forged-summary fixture (3-6 lines). HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 3
